data.description:

She has brown eyes. She has a silver navel piercing. She has a plantigrade stance, meaning she stands on the soles of her feet, with four toes on each foot. She wears green nail polish on both her hands and feet. She has a blunt muzzle with nostrils and buckteeth. She has small ears atop her head. Lacey wears pink cropped tube-top, pink short-shorts with no panties, a blue thigh band that holds five condoms, and white-blue ankle bracelet.

She's far more street-smart than smart-smart, but she makes up for her brains (or lack thereof) with her sexual prowess. She's "invented" her own sex technique, it's this weird swirly thing she does with her tongue. The boys call it the "Cinnamon Roll" and man does it feel good. She's a dick-sucking pro. She's a bit silly. She does this balancing trick where she balances an orange on her head while riding someone. She is surprisingly quite good at it. She's friendly, sociable, honestly? She's kind of a sweetheart, no wonder the boys like her.
